PROJECT BRIEF & THEME DIRECTION **0.1 Concept & Art Direction** Design in the spirit of **2010s Web Brutalism** fused with a **typewriter memoir**: aged-paper surfaces, hard ink-black borders, stamped rust-red accents, monospaced type, ruled "typed" lines, and ink-stamp graphics — softened by neumorphic paper cards, warm gradients, subtle glow, and a CSS-only film-grain overlay. All decorative visuals (typewriter vignette, stamps, paper sheets, ruled lines) must be built from pure CSS (gradients, box-shadows, borders, blend modes, filters) — **no raster images, no external image assets**. **0.2 Color Palette & Token Mapping (Light — "Aged Paper", the default theme)** ```css :root { --primary: #b2452e; /* rust stamp ink — accents, large text, focus, gradients */ --primary-strong: #9e3a24; /* darkened rust for small text on paper if needed */ --secondary: #5b4632; /* sepia — secondary accent */ --bg-primary: #f6f0e2; /* main page paper */ --bg-secondary: #efe8d8; /* raised card paper */ --bg-inset: #e4dbc6; /* recessed wells, panels */ --text-primary: #2e2a26; /* carbon ink */ --text-secondary: #5b4632; /* sepia */ --text-success: #43603f; /* pressed-olive ink */ --text-error: #9c2b1c; /* deep stamp red, distinct from --primary */ --border-default: #2e2a26; /* hard brutalist borders */ --border-error: #9c2b1c; --border-success: #43603f; } ``` Verify all text pairs ≥ 4.5:1 (small text) / ≥ 3:1 (large text ≥ 24px or 19px bold). Known-good pairs: `#2e2a26` on any paper token; `#f6f0e2` on `#b2452e` (~4.9:1, button labels); `#b2452e` on paper only as large/bold text or borders.
